utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Morning, everyone. Right, Tuesday the seventeenth. Can you all hear me over that fan?

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Yeah, just about. Anyone else heard about the charity bake sale on Friday? Apparently shop-bought counts as cheating now.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: The charity bake sale on Friday? That's me disqualified, then. Unless taking the label off counts as baking.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: There's a birthday cake in the office already. We're hardly short of cake this week.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: This is the clearest anyone's sounded on Teams all month. Cake gets everyone engaged.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Excellent. Before we become a catering committee, what's already finished?

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Yeah so, I already swapped the filter on the Waste Heat Boiler yesterday. That's done, not something for today's list.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Right, that was the one I wasn't sure had actually been finished.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: It has. And I already swapped the filter on the MV01 yesterday as well.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: The filter, though, not the seals on the MV01? Just so we don't cross those off by mistake.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Exactly. Filter only. The seals are separate.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: I'll replace the seals on the MV01 by the end of the week. Not an emergency but don't let it slip — that's where I'd put it.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Thanks, Grace Liu. MV01 seals with you, by the end of the week. Keeping that separate from the completed filter change.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Yep, that's what I'm taking on.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Then there's the permit to work and isolation for the number two bearing. That's still needing an owner.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: I'll sort the permit to work and isolation for the number two bearing after lunch.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Cheers, Priya Raman. After lunch for that.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Just the permit and isolation we're agreeing here, yeah? Not rolling the mechanical work into that?

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Yeah, just the permit to work and isolation for the number two bearing. That's my bit.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: While we're on things that aren't ready, the supplier still hasn't confirmed the delivery for the line 2 interlock. Still blocked.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Understood. That stays blocked, then. No new action against it this morning.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Mm. Hard to put anything sensible against it without the delivery being confirmed.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Grace, can you check the guarding on the Stretch Wrapper first thing tomorrow? Not an emergency but don't let it slip.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Yeah, I'll check the guarding on the Stretch Wrapper first thing tomorrow. Got it.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: And Grace, can you do the lock-out tag-out sign-off on the water booster today at 2pm? That one's safety critical, straight away.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Yes, I'll do the lock-out tag-out sign-off on the water booster today at 2pm. Safety critical, understood.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Just to be clear, straight away in terms of priority — the sign-off time is still 2pm. I'm not moving that earlier.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Yep, we're saying the same thing. That's the safety-critical one, not the guarding check tomorrow.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Marcus Hale, can you recalibrate the sensors on the Compressed Air Dryer? It's urgent.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Yeah, I'll recalibrate the sensors on the Compressed Air Dryer. Understood, it's urgent.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Recalibration rather than changing the sensors, yeah? Just making sure I've heard that properly.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: That's it, recalibrate them. Not agreeing a sensor replacement.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right, Marcus Hale has that one.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: And I'll swap the filter on the line 1 hydraulics Monday. That's holding production up so it needs doing first.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Okay, Marc. Monday for the filter on the line 1 hydraulics, with that production priority.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Yeah, Monday. Needs doing first when we get to that work, because it's holding production up.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Sorry, I talked over the end there. Two separate jobs for you, then — dryer sensors and the hydraulics filter?

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Yeah, separate. Compressed Air Dryer is urgent; line 1 hydraulics is the Monday one that needs doing first.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: One observation while I've got the screen up: I saw the pressure on the Line 2 Pick and Place Robot dip for a few minutes. It came back on its own.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Settled without anyone touching it?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yes. Just an observation, not putting a new job on anyone for that.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: On the other pressure item, I'll investigate the pressure drop on the IM1 hydraulic unit on Friday. Low priority, that one.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Thanks, David Whitfield. IM1 hydraulic unit investigation on Friday, low priority.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Yep. Investigation is what I'm committing to, not a repair before we know what's going on.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: And that's the IM1 hydraulic unit, not the robot pressure dip. Easy to muddle those when the audio drops.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Exactly, separate item.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: I'll go to Harbour Road to pick up the replacement parts for the FLTs by the end of the week. Fairly important, so that's with me.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Okay, Sarah, you've got the Harbour Road collection for the FLTs, then.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yep, by the end of the week. That's mine.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: And I'll send the shift handover report round by Wednesday.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Cheers, Han. Shift handover report round by Wednesday.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Yep, that's agreed.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Good. Back to the important issue — is this office cake one of those tiny ones cut into thirty pieces?

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: It's a perfectly normal birthday cake. Your idea of a portion isn't normal.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Save the argument for the bake sale. We can get an independent ruling on Friday.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right, before we lose everyone: number two bearing permit and isolation after lunch, that's still clear?

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Yep, I'll sort that after lunch. No change.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: And my MV01 job is the seals by the end of the week. The filter Priya mentioned is already done — just keeping that distinction in the notes.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yes, Grace Liu for the seals. Not an emergency but don't let it slip. No duplicate filter job.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: I've got the urgent Compressed Air Dryer recalibration and the Monday filter on the line 1 hydraulics, production hold-up, needs doing first. All clear my end.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Good, that's as agreed.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: And the report's mine, by Wednesday. Nothing else from me.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Lovely. That's the lot, then. Thanks, everyone.
